evidence.reason: The current merge bar binds the CRQ PASS to the exact head SHA (contract items 12/18), and the refresh receipt POST sends that exact `commit_id`; the body records the historical scanned `base..head` range. The finding itself admits the review API has no base binding, so the proposed recheck only narrows a best-effort race and does not make the receipt base-bound. That is hardening of an API limitation, not a current requirement or an ordinary correctness defect: a later base move does not make the head-bound PASS false under the contract's exact-head rule.
